gate.note: Offensive players matched to nflverse by normalized name and team (fallback: last name + team + position, then name only when unique). Sleeper players with 0.0 actual and no nflverse row are consistent by construction and are not counted.

scope.def_note: DEF scored from play-by-play including three-and-outs and fourth-down stops; all 32 week-1 2026 defenses matched Sleeper exactly.

slot_gaps.manager_rule: naive (start by season average to date; prior-season ppg in week 1)

limitations: No archive of Sleeper's weekly projections exists, so this harness cannot tune w, the weight on Sleeper's number in the live blend; it tunes only the baseline half that Sleeper is blended against.
Rosters in the lineup simulation are fixed for the season (drafted from prior-season points per game); no waivers or trades, and rookies with no prior season are not drafted.
Only players with a stat row in a week are eligible for that week's lineup, which is how Sleeper treats ruled-out players but assumes the manager knew every inactive in advance.
Week 1 is not evaluated (no in-season data); every model falls back to the prior-season number there.
Injury status, weather, Vegas totals and depth-chart news are not in the data.

headline: Scoring gate: 357 offensive players and 32 defenses reproduced Sleeper's week-1 2026 points, 0 mismatches.
vol:0.5:4:0.1+opp:0.5:4:0.2 beat the naive baseline on lineup points: +1.30 per team-week, 95% interval +0.14 to +2.50 over 17 weeks; MAE -0.115 (-0.252 to -0.012).
vol:0.5:4:0.1+opp:0.5:4:0.2 did NOT beat the engine's k=4 baseline half on lineup points: +0.20 per team-week, 95% interval -0.73 to +1.09 over 17 weeks; MAE -0.029 (-0.046 to -0.012).
Leakage test passed (32 week x model checks); determinism test passed.
